mapper.select: SELECT UL.LOGIN_ID,UL.ROLES_ID,UL.USER_PASSWORD,UD.USER_ID,UD.USER_NAME,UD.USER_NICKNAME, UD.USER_GENDER,UD.USER_BIRTH,UD.USER_CREATED_AT,UD.USER_TEL,UD.USER_ZIPCODE,UD.USER_ADDR, UD.USER_EMAIL,UD.USER_IMG FROM user_login UL JOIN user_detail UD ON UL.USER_ID = UD.USER_ID WHERE UL.LOGIN_ID = #{login_id}
